summary: Interpreter is INTERPRET, two F hands twisting against each other, followed by the PERSON marker, two flat hands sliding down the sides of the body.
steps: Make F handshapes with both hands and touch them together at the fingertips.
Twist them back and forth against each other (INTERPRET).
Add the PERSON marker: both flat hands, palms facing, slide straight down in front of your body.
note: When an interpreter is working, talk to the Deaf person, not the interpreter. Look at them, say 'you,' and let the interpreter do their job in the background.
mistakes: Skipping the PERSON ending. Without it, you've signed the verb 'interpret.'
